Name: Lowkey Spring Interface Recolor
Author: perlade
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/C1hmtxF.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]I'm a big fan of muted colors, and I particularly love muted roses and corals. The mod features these, alongside a heavy dose of sage and greens for a very muted palette with some floral, cherry blossom, and other green accents. I primarily made this for myself, but it's a pretty elaborate project, so I decided to share it here. This is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] Mod and works as any other mod does.
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ef8l50F.png[/img]

[size=3]These are pretty limited for now.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Flower Overlay[/b]: Toggle True/False. You can remove some of the flower overlays (Menus, ﻿the primary panel, etc), by removing this option.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Cursors[/b]: Toggle True/False. The cursors are kind of a lot, if you want the standard stardew ones, you can remove them via this option.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]﻿Quality Stars[/b]: ﻿Toggle True/False.These are fairly muted and may cause some visibility issues for some folks, so I wanted to make sure people had the option to remove them.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]﻿Marimo Artifact Spot[/b]: ﻿﻿Toggle True/False. Marimo (Japanese moss balls) are cute (imo) but they're also kinda weird! Remove if you don't like it.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/AZsuaKQ.png[/img][/size]
[size=3]This mod should work with 1.6. I have not tested with other versions so use at your own peril. It also has a few built in compatibility patches for other mods. All mods need to have their art added into the original mod art folders, except for Vanilla Tweaks UI. That should automatically load if you have it installed. There are also some images for the SVE farm icons, if you want change those out.
[/size]
